name: My Good Intentions
source:
Interactive romance visual novels that follows the story of a teenage boy trying to be "friends" with a girl his age he made at an anime convention, while she is trying to hide who she really is so he doesn't end up disliking her.

[From [url=https://cianmuffin.itch.io/my-good-intentions]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
互动浪漫视觉小说，讲述了一个十几岁的男孩试图与他在动漫大会上结识的同龄女孩成为“朋友”的故事，而她则试图隐藏自己的真实身份，这样他就不会讨厌她。

[来自[url=https://cianmuffin.itch.io/my-good-intentions]Itch.io[/url]]
